fees.source: fs.usda.gov Princess page ('Single Site: $36 per night Double Site: $71 per night RV Dump Station Fee: $20.00'; '$8.00/night on the 2nd vehicle') + recreation.gov 232782 rate tables 2026-2028, read 2026-11-27

values.note: The first two weeks after opening (about May 8-21 in 2026) are first-come, first-served; reservations cover the peak season from late May to late September. One standard site is not reservable. 14 nights in any rolling 30 days.

booking.source: recreation.gov 232782 rates ('First-come, First-served Season' 2026-05-08..05-21; 'Peak Season' 2026-05-22..09-26) + rules (maxStay 14 days 'Rolling 30 Days') + catalog (one STANDARD site not reservable), read 2026-11-27

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog 232782: every site STANDARD NONELECTRIC or TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC, no water/sewer hookups, read 2026-11-27

sites.source: recreation.gov catalog 232782 (82 sites, RV max length to 50 ft, all 'Back-In'), read 2026-11-27

facilities.source: recreation.gov 232782 amenities ('Drinking Water', 'Vault Toilets') + notice ('This campground has a dump station onsite, fee is $20.00'), read 2026-11-27

values.note: 2026 ran May 8 (first-come) to September 26; the 2027 reservation season is May 28 - September 25, and the 2025 season was May 23 - September 26.

season.source: recreation.gov 232782 rate seasons 2026/2027 + fs.usda.gov ('Seasons of Use May 23 - September 26, 2025'; 'Site Closed' in November), read 2026-11-27

note: Sequoia National Forest campground on Hwy 180 in the Indian Basin Grove beside Indian Basin Meadow, 3 miles from Hume Lake and on the way to Kings Canyon; three loops among giant sequoia stumps, with dirt and gravel parking spurs. Run by a concessionaire. --Claude
summary: FS page, recreation.gov record + catalog, imagery read. Seasonal (2026: May 8 FCFS, May 22-Sep 26 reserved; 2027 peak May 28-Sep 25), closed for the season now. $36 single / $71 double, $8 extra vehicle, $20 dump. 82 sites (stored 69), 63 take 23 ft+, max 50, back-in; no hookups; vault toilets, water, dump. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin 129 m from centroid - fine.
